atoms.b: The_doctor_examined_a_patient ((who had been hit by an ambulance)). “Well,”_he_said,_looking_at_the_X-rays,_“you_seem_to_have_broken_quite_a_few_bones_in_your_body. hint.text:
allusion: indirect reference to a person, place, or event
cliché: overused phrase that has lost originality
exaggeration: deliberate overstatement
verbal irony: saying the opposite of what is meant
situational irony: result is opposite of expectation
dramatic irony: audience knows more than the characters
juxtaposition: contrasting ideas placed side by side
hint.label: hint

atoms.b: The_war_was ((hell and heaven, destruction and creation)) happening_simultaneously. ((Like David facing Goliath)), our_small_town_fought_against_injustice. ((But honestly, wasn't it just common sense that the little guy always wins?)) Our_victory_was_guaranteed_-_after_all, ((what goes around comes around.))
